source: FBR Circular No. 02 of 2026-27 · Finance Act 2026
headline: IT EXPORTERS:
THE 0.25% RATE

items: **IT and IT-enabled services exports:** reduced **0.25%** advance tax extended to tax year **2029**
**Other exports:** advance tax fixed at **1.25%** as minimum tax
**Working independently for local clients?** Software developers face **15%** withholding
